label: preparing
what: Likely a shared great-hall gathering with a substantial bread supply, possibly a surprise accompanying the day-1 18:00 lighting inspection. Innkeeper and freight repeatedly stocked the same hall chest, funded supplies, and passed bread to builder for deposit; baker supplied additional bread. The record does not establish the precise occasion or that baker knew of any secrecy. The mayor was told about and approved the lighting inspection; no shown record tells him about the coordinated food preparation. Deliberate concealment, and knowing assistance by secretary or neighbour, remain unproven.
